title: Battle of Zboriv
summary: The Battle of Zboriv refers to two significant historical conflicts associated with [[ukraine|Ukraine]], one during the Khmelnytsky Uprising in the 17th century and another during World War I in the early 20th century.

sections.heading: Battle of Zboriv (1649)
paragraphs: The Battle of Zboriv, fought in 1649 near the town of [[zboriv|Zboriv]], was a crucial engagement during the [[khmelnytsky-uprising|Khmelnytsky Uprising]], a rebellion led by [[zaporozhian-cossacks|Ukrainian Cossacks]] against Polish-Lithuanian rule.

sections.heading: Battle of Zborov (1917)
paragraphs: The Battle of Zborov occurred in July 1917 and was a minor engagement that formed part of the Kerensky Offensive, which was the final Russian offensive during World War I.
